replications.journal: Advances in Methods and Practices in Psychological Science
replications.quote: This result did not support the hypothesis that subjective well-being is higher for participants exposed to descriptions of higher SMS. The effect was small in magnitude, much smaller than the original effect, and in the opposite direction (d = −0.04, 95% CI = [−0.09, 0.004], vs. original d = 0.57).

effect.name: Local sociometric status raises subjective well-being
